OFFICE OF PLANNING AND PROGRAMMING
BOX 94601 . STATE CAPITOL . LINCOLN, NEBRASKA 685
Governor J. James Exon State Planning Officer
W. Don Nelson Director
. May 2, 1972
Mr. Yates M. Barber, Jr. Chief, Office of Environmental Quality Bureau of Sport Fisheries and Wildlife U. S. Department of the Interior Washington, D. C.
Dear Mr. Barber:
Project No. 72-03-31-58 Endangered Species Conservation Act
According to the provisions of ONE Circular A-95, this office has reviewed the Draft Environmental Statement for the proposed Endangered Species Conservation Act of 1972, submitted by the U. S. Department of the Interior.
The Draft Environmental Statement was reviewed by several state agencies; and comments were received from the Nebraska Game and Parks Commission. Please find these comments enclosed, and consider them in the final planning process.
The submission of this letter completes the state clearinghouse function.
Sincerely,

Company

Jim Barr
Natural Resources Coordinator
